# Nishit Rana — Portfolio

## About
Nishit Rana is a Founding Engineer (SDE 1) at Cognerd working across AI systems, backend and infrastructure. He builds LLM agents and eval harnesses, the PostgreSQL schemas and job queues behind them, the payment rails that monetise them, and the AWS servers they run on. He graduated in 2025, went from intern to founding engineer within six months, leads technical delivery and supervises three interns.

## Experience
- **Founding Engineer (SDE 1), Cognerd** (Feb 2026 – present): grounded PydanticAI agents with citations and claim verification; eval datasets and regression gates; 20+ REST APIs and 10+ PostgreSQL tables; three durable PostgreSQL + BullMQ job systems; Razorpay billing; multi-tenant RBAC; migration of four production services onto EC2/RDS defined in CloudFormation.
- **Backend Developer Intern, Welzin** (Aug 2025 – Jan 2026): Node.js/Python brand-monitoring APIs with OpenRouter/OpenAI/Grok, MongoDB, RAG and n8n; Linux deployments behind Nginx.

## Work
- **AGXP** — Cloudflare edge delivery for AI crawlers, built at Cognerd: serves LLM-transformed HTML variants from Workers/KV with origin fallback. Repository private.
- **AgentGraph** — agent observability and tool intelligence: trace/span ingestion, waterfall timelines, token/cost analytics, TypeScript and Python SDKs. https://github.com/nrana-pixel/AgentGraph
- **Product → UGC video pipeline** — n8n + Vertex AI Veo, productised as a UGC video studio at Cognerd.
- **Optimus CLI** — terminal AI coding assistant with an MCP client and Ollama/OpenAI-compatible streaming. https://github.com/nrana-pixel/optimus-cli

## Skills
AI: PydanticAI, MCP, RAG, Vertex AI / Veo, Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, eval datasets and regression gates.
Backend: TypeScript, Python, Go, SQL, Node.js, Express, Hono, FastAPI, Next.js, React.
Data: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, Cloudflare D1, Qdrant, Redis/Valkey, BullMQ.
Infra: AWS (EC2, RDS, ALB, S3, CloudFront, ElastiCache, CloudFormation, CodePipeline), Cloudflare Workers/KV/R2, Linux, systemd, Nginx, Docker, Kubernetes.
